text: Toggle features on/off remotely without deploying new code
quote: Make changes remotely: Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code

text: Wrap a section of code in a flag and toggle it per environment, user, or segment
quote: Just wrap a section of code with a flag, and then use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.

text: Target features to users based on specific traits like geography, subscription level or device type
quote: Target features to users with specific traits (such as geography, subscription level, device type, or application version).

text: Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, globally or within a segment
quote: Rollouts by percentage (also known as staged feature rollouts) allow you to test a new feature with a small subset of your user base.

text: Override feature flags for individual users (identities) for QA, support or personalization
quote: Override feature flags for individual users ("identities"). Enables internal testing, QA, customer support, or personalised experiences at the user level.

text: Multivariate flags define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n)
quote: Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).

text: Scheduled flags queue flag changes to apply automatically at a specified future time
quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time, eliminating the need for manual intervention at the exact moment of change.

text: Release pipelines define stages flags progress through automatically, with triggers/actions controlling rollout to environments and audiences
quote: Define stages that your flags progress through automatically, with triggers and actions that control rollouts to selected environments and audiences.

text: Run end-to-end A/B and multivariate experiments on the platform
quote: Flagsmith Experimentation lets you run A/B tests end to end on the platform: serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag, collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Ba

text: Collect application events into a managed data warehouse to power experiment metrics
quote: collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.

text: Analyze experiment results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine
quote: read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine

text: Every action in the admin app is tracked and logged for auditing
quote: Every action taken within the Flagsmith administration application is tracked and logged. This allows you to easily retrace the events and values that flags, identities and segments have taken over time.

text: Stream audit logs to your own infrastructure via Audit Log Webhooks
quote: You can stream your Audit Logs into your own infrastructure using Audit Log Webhooks.

text: Feature Change Requests give a create/approve/publish workflow like GitHub Pull Requests
quote: Feature Change Requests help creating a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) to updating feature flags, similarly to Pull Requests in GitHub.

text: Role-based access control (RBAC) offers fine-grained permission management of resources
quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) provides fine-grained access management of Flagsmith resources.

text: Self-host the complete Flagsmith platform on your own infrastructure, including via Docker
quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.

text: Run a self-hosted Edge Proxy so the Flagsmith Engine runs close to your servers
quote: The Flagsmith Edge Proxy is a service that you host yourself, that allows you to run an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers.

text: Flagsmith MCP Server exposes the Admin API to AI assistants and agents via Model Context Protocol
quote: The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol

text: Official CLI manages flags, segments, features, projects and environments, and evaluates flags like an SDK
quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.

text: SAML/SSO authentication support for login
quote: SAML/SSO Authentication

text: Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps
quote: Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps.

text: Offers 15+ language SDKs and framework integrations such as React and Next.js
quote: Choose from 15+ popular languages like Typescript, .NET, Java, and more. Integrate with any framework, including React, Next.js, and more

text: Restrict which users can modify production environments
quote: Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.

text: Anything doable in the dashboard can also be done via the Admin API
quote: Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.

text: Define segments of users via trait-based rules and override flags for whole segments
quote: Define segments—groups of users matching rules based on traits (e.g., location, plan, app version, usage). Override feature flags for all users in a segment.

text: Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
quote: Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production, eliminating manual effort and streamlining your deployment workflow.

text: Release Pipelines act as an automated release assistant for the entire deployment process
quote: Release Pipelines act as your intelligent release assistant, automating your entire feature flag deployment process.

text: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) available for account security
quote: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

text: Mark flags as protected to prevent accidental deletion
quote: add `protected` to prevent them from accidentally being deleted

text: Mark a flag as server-side only so it can't be accessed by client-side SDKs
quote: **Server-side only**: enabling this prevents your flag from being accessed by client-side SDKs.

text: Environment Key is a public, non-secret key safe to expose in client-side code
quote: Authentication: Uses a public, non-secret Environment Key. Security: Open by design. The Environment Key can be exposed in client-side code.

text: Admin API lets you programmatically create, update, and delete projects, environments, flags, segments and users
quote: Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
